warhead.provenance: Warhead mass not public for PL-15 or PL-15E. Engineering-estimate surrogate scaled from the repo AIM-120D pattern for a comparable BVR AAM class.

fuze.provenance: No public fuze data; engineering-estimate active-radar proximity fuze scaffold typical of a modern BVR AAM, matching the repo AIM-120D convention.

_real_world.designation: PL-15 (PLA service variant); export variant PL-15E
_real_world.role: Primary long-range beyond-visual-range (BVR) active-radar air-to-air missile of PLA/PLANAF fighters
_real_world.carrier_platforms: J-35 (internal bay; CCTV designer programme via SCMP shows up to 6 AAMs internal, mix unstated), J-15T, J-15 (csg-cn-j35-scmp-cctv, B; csg-cn-pl15-cma-blog, C)
_real_world.range_km: PLA service variant: 'over 200' / 200-300 / 150-200 km (csg-cn-pl15-armyrec, csg-cn-pl15-wiki, C-only; TWZ B-tier 'reported maximum range around 124 miles (~200 km)' secondary). Export PL-15E: >145 km (csg-cn-pl15e-scmp-avic, B/export, AVIC Weibo via SCMP, manufacturer claim, NOT a PLAN figure)
_real_world.speed: Mach 4 (military source via SCMP for PL-15E, B/export) to Mach 5+ (csg-cn-pl15-wiki, C)
_real_world.propulsion: Dual-pulse solid rocket motor (csg-cn-pl15-twz B; csg-cn-pl15-armyrec C)
_real_world.guidance_real: INS (+BeiDou) midcourse, two-way datalink, terminal active AESA radar seeker with active/passive modes (csg-cn-pl15-twz, B; Ku-band claim is C-only blog)
_real_world.dimensions_mass: PL-15E: 3,996 mm length, 203 mm diameter, <=210 kg (csg-cn-pl15-gs, C-only/export, Zhuhai display board)
_real_world.internal_carriage_variant: Folded-fin PL-15 variant (2024 Zhuhai) enabling up to 6 in J-20/J-35 bays; some sources call it 'PL-16', designation unresolved (csg-cn-pl15-cma-blog, csg-cn-pl15-wiki, C-only)
_real_world.combat_use: PL-15E used by Pakistan AF in May 2025 India-Pakistan air battle; debris recovered in India, performance not publicly quantified (csg-cn-pl15-twz, B)
_real_world.status: functional weapon, wired to J-35/J-15T/J-15D default_loadout per aircraft records

modeling_notes: PLA service-variant range has no A/B figure; only the export PL-15E (>145 km, AVIC/SCMP) is B-tier. This record models the PLA service variant per carrier-aircraft use, using the wider C-only 150-300 km band rather than the lower export figure, since the PLA in-service round is understood to outperform the export variant.
